name: Fairmont Quasar Istanbul
positioning: Fairmont's city hotel in Istanbul's Mecidiyeköy business district, with floor-to-ceiling windows, a Fairmont Gold lounge and a spa with a traditional hammam
best_for: Travelers who want a central Istanbul base with close access to both the European and Asian sides
Guests who want a spa and hammam on site

facts.text: The hotel stands over the slopes of the Bosphorus in the Mecidiyeköy business district.
The hotel's location gives close access to both the European and Asian sides of Istanbul.
Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows over Istanbul's skyline.
Guests can choose a bathtub or a private Turkish bath in the standard rooms, which also have rain showers.
The one-bedroom Bosphorus View suites have a private balcony and Gold Lounge access.
The Bosphorus Terrace Suite has a terrace with panoramic Bosphorus views and a dining table for six.
Fairmont Gold guests have a private lounge with complimentary treats through the day and a dedicated butler team.
Fairmont Spa has swimming pools, a fitness center, treatment rooms and a traditional hammam.
A heated indoor pool is located at Fairmont Spa.
The hotel offers a Turkish hammam ritual called Luxury Hammam by gülsha.
The hotel is pet-friendly and has a Canine Ambassador named Gofret.
Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel among its Readers' Choice Awards for 2019 and 2023.
